operators.name: erf_forward
semantics: Computes elementwise error function: erf(x) = 2/sqrt(pi) * integral_0^x exp(-t^2) dt
Preserves input shape, dtype, device, and strides semantics
Corresponds to reference statement: x = torch.erf(x)

operators.name: median_dim0_forward

returns.shape: container with values tensor [1024] float32 and indices tensor [1024] int64

semantics: Computes median along dimension 0 for each column independently
Returns a named tuple containing values (float32) and indices (int64)
For even number of elements, lower median is chosen as in torch.median
Indices are computed as the position of the median value in the sorted order (stable order)
Corresponds to reference statement: x = torch.median(x, dim=0)
Elementwise error function applied to input tensor x
Elementwise error function applied again to the result of previous step
Computes median and indices along dimension 0
Returns torch.return_types.median with values [1024] float32 and indices [1024] int64
Returns the median result container unchanged
